children: Limbach entered into a $300 million senior secured credit facility with PNC Bank and other lenders, replacing its prior Wintrust revolving credit line. The new agreement includes a $200 million revolver, a $50 million term loan, and a $50 million delayed draw term loan, maturing Sep 9, 2031, with pricing tied to leverage. Concurrently, Limbach terminated the $125 million Wintrust facility and repaid about $118.1 million of principal with proceeds from the new financing. Management expects the transaction to enhance liquidity for working capital, acquisitions, and general corporate purposes.
: Senior secured $300 million credit facility (revolver, term loan, delayed draw term)
: Refinance debt and support growth and acquisitions
: Replaced by larger PNC credit facility
